statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security and privacy lead in writing
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual evaluation with an outside reviewer every second year
Annual policy review; written, time-limited exceptions
Approval before any new device, app, or vendor feature; P10 for AI
No audio and no face recognition on cameras
Separate building-device network; guest isolation; nothing exposed to the internet
Change default passwords; unique router passphrase
Automatic firmware updates on; quarterly router check
Device list and network sketch kept current
Contractor security terms with 72-hour incident notice
No standing contractor administrator accounts
Annual review of the access control vendor's SOC 2 report and customer controls
Own accounts; no shared credentials
MFA by app on every account that offers it
16-character unique passphrases in a password manager; none in the browser
Building credentials: named requests, 1-day departure notice, monthly review, annual tenant confirmation
Named sharing only; no anyone-with-the-link sharing
Standard laptop account for daily work
Device lock; phone remote wipe
Monthly review of admin changes, after-hours door events, sign-ins, and router devices
Three-level data classification
Restricted data only in approved locations
Laptop full-disk encryption; phone passcode
Owner-controlled backups; monthly access control export; annual restore test
Payment-change call-back rule
Retention and disposal of guarantor files, credit reports, video, and door history
Security records kept at least 5 years
Official software sources; updates, antivirus on; no unknown USB devices
AI tools only after a P10 assessment and approval
Camera signs state video, no audio
Annual security training for the owner
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Record the Florida determination date; meet the P08 deadlines
No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Manual procedures, sealed envelope, contractor fallback
